title: Chapter 2 · Two players
description: Gerard (player 1) and Aitor (player 2, second controller) in the Meridiana flat: Aitor follows until a second controller connects, then walks on his own with the camera framing both; the status screen splits in two, Gerard's half on the left and Aitor's on the right, and the Noísta ánima is shared; in a fight each player picks their own fighter's moves, and Aitor's turn waits while there is no second controller. Two standard gamepads are faked in the page.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads;

steps.caption: One controller: Aitor walks round the bed and follows Gerard
A second controller connects: Aitor walks on his own and the camera frames both
Estado with two players: Gerard's half on the left, Aitor's on the right, each with their own stats
Ánimas in Aitor's half: he puts Noísta on (Magia +2, Espíritu +2, Defensa −1)
A fight: Gerard (faster) goes first, on player 1's keyboard
Aitor's turn belongs to player 2's controller; the keyboard is ignored
Without a second controller Aitor's turn waits for player 2
